name: Hotel Schiestl
beschreibung: Hotel Schiestl is positioned on a peaceful hillside in Fügenberg, overlooking Fügen in the Zillertal Valley. The family-operated resort combines traditional Tyrolean character with exceptional wellness amenities, including indoor and outdoor pools, saunas, and dedicated family spa zones. In winter, it is conveniently located near the Spieljoch and Hochfügen ski areas, while summer offers panoramic hiking trails. Delicious regional half-board dining rounds off the experience.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Schiestl in Fügenberg in the Zillertal features family-friendly alpine comfort, an extensive spa with indoor and outdoor pools, saunas, and proximity to Spieljoch.
